answer: Random peer audit stops fake identities. Each epoch, every agent gets 3 random auditors from the oasis pool, each staking 20 POA. Auditors re-run a sample of the agent's river of past work: a fake record slashes its deposit, half paid to the auditor as bounty. 100 fakes cost 8,000 POA (2,000 deposits + 6,000 stakes), while one honest agent risks only 20 POA and keeps its full reward. Caught twice, an identity earns an umber mark and no new work.
